question: According to John 20:31, why were these signs written down?
options: So that you may believe that Jesus is the Messiah, the Son of God, and have life in his name
To record the history of Rome
To give rules for the temple
To list the miracles of the prophets
explanation: John 20:31 says these are written that you may believe that Jesus is the Messiah, the Son of God, and that by believing you may have life in his name.
